caption: The video captures a close, low-angle view of a shallow rocky stream where a small cascade tumbles over a cluster of stones in the upper-center and pours into a calm, tan-tinted pool filling the foreground. The falling sheet of water shifts slightly in width and texture as the flow passes. The white frothy splash at its base churns and reshapes itself without starting or stopping. Fixed boulders frame the scene: pale gray rocks at the upper left, a large moss-covered boulder at the upper right, and a smooth amber stone at the right edge. Several rounded submerged stones are visible through the clear water in the foreground. Ripples and shimmering highlights move across the pool surface, altering the apparent outline and brightness of those stones through refraction. A tiny red fragment rests near the right boulder, holding its position. The rocks and water level stay constant as the continuous flow persists.
